tolerance_rationale: MgO rocksalt / STO-3G / LDA / Γ-only. STO-3G underbinds heavy ionic systems badly; the basis-set-error noise floor between vibe-qc and pyscf at this minimal-basis level is ~10 mHa per cell. 20 mHa catches real bugs (Madelung, gauge) without flagging legitimate basis noise.
published_source: Peintinger 2013 J. Comput. Chem. 34, 451 SI Table 1 — pob-TZVP / PW1PW / multi-k. Advisory only at this (basis, method, kmesh): the published reference is at pob-TZVP basis with PW1PW and full Brillouin-zone integration; vibe-qc here runs sto-3g / RKS-LDA / Γ-only. Strict numerical match needs PW1PW + multi-k + pob-TZVP (queued for v0.8+ per docs/roadmap.md).
published_source_hf: Peintinger 2013 SI Table 2 — pob-TZVP / HF / multi-k. Same level-of-theory caveats as PW1PW above.
